description: After payment, use the delivery token to list files or read rows. Every delivery lists json (the original records) and fields.json (which requested fields were found, with path and type) together. csv and xlsx appear only when the records are already flat and do not replace fields.json. rows pages the original records. A paid excess-rows add-on has its own extra.json and extra.fields.json, plus extra.csv and extra.xlsx only when those rows are flat. XLSX is returned as base64 bytes with its content type. All rows pages for a file count once per token; a full download counts once each. On expiry or download_limit, call get_order with your order capability for a fresh token. A current session is required and the delivery token is bound to it. If the original session expired, initialize a new one and call get_order first.

order_id.description: Order number, e.g. GMD7K3P9Q. Lowercase or hyphenated input (gmd-7k3p9q) is accepted.
